name: allo-dechets-maquette-accueil
description: Maquette locale de la page d’accueil ALLÔ DÉCHETS

scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 5180 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory public
scripts.check: node --check public/app.js && node --check public/navigation.js && node scripts/build.mjs --check && node scripts/check-styles.mjs
scripts.build:pages: npm run build && npm run check && node scripts/build-pages.mjs
